name: Rhetoricer
source:
In the year 2050, so-called Rhetoricers fight against monsters using rhetoric.
Kengo, a university student majoring in psychology goes forward in time from 
2040 to 2050 and meets a Rhetoricer girl named Iroha...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE236568.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
2050年，被称为“修辞师”的人使用修辞与怪物战斗。主修心理学的大学生健吾从2040年穿越到2050年，遇见一名名叫彩露叶的修辞师女孩……
